headline: Early receivables-automation discovery with a branch finance lead; central team owns most processes

suggested_routes.label: Deal / partner next step
suggested_routes.rationale: Exploratory discovery with interest in receiving material; no meeting or evaluation agreed.
suggested_routes.output: Send the receivables and expense material plus the security/compliance documentation promised in turns 29 and 32. Before investing more, find out who in the central finance team owns collections. The contact handles one branch (turn 2), and "the dedicated central team handles much of this today" (turn 25).

suggested_routes.label: Sales coaching
suggested_routes.rationale: Discovery was thorough, but the buyer's authority was not established.
suggested_routes.output: Coaching note: the discovery questions on invoice flow and volume were good, and the rep corrected their own count-vs-value confusion (turns 13–15). Next time, qualify authority: the person is a branch finance lead and central teams own payables and collections (turns 7, 25).

evidence.quote: I handle finance for one branch of Mapletrail Services.
evidence.supports: The contact's scope is a single branch.

evidence.quote: For supplier payments there is a dedicated team.
One expense-recovery invoice has been outstanding for months
These are rough numbers in this conversation, not a report I have open.
But the dedicated central team handles much of this today.
Confidentiality is important. Payment information is sensitive.
Please send the information and we can stay in touch.

concise_output: Discovery with a branch finance lead at Mapletrail Services about receivables automation. There is real collections pain (an invoice outstanding for months), but central teams own most processes, volumes are rough, and the close was 'send information and stay in touch'.
what_established: Branch-level role; roughly 390–520 invoices a month company-wide (a rough estimate); manual tracking of contract terms and receipts; security is a concern; the contact asked for material.
what_not_established: Buying authority, budget, timeline, or interest from the central finance team. Invoice volume is the contact's rough estimate.
next_action: Send material with security docs; identify the central collections owner.
uncertainty: Volumes were revised during the call; the speaker said they are rough.
